name: vscwclang
description: vscwClang contains Clang and Lldb as webasm binaries, allowing VSC for Web to compile and debug C++ code entirely in the browser.

vscwclang.toolchainUrl.markdownDescription: Development override: directory URL serving a toolchain made by `scripts/make-toolchain-dist.mjs` (`manifest.json` plus chunks). When set, the manifest is trusted as served instead of being checked against the hash pinned in the extension. Leave empty to use the pinned toolchain. The host must send CORS and `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin` headers.

vscwclang.flags.markdownDescription: Extra flags for `vscwClang: Build` and `Build and Run`. `/workspace` is your workspace folder, so the default `-I/workspace` lets sources include headers relative to the project root (`#include "utils/foo.hpp"`). `-l`, `-L` and `-Wl,` flags go to the linker; restricted flags (`--target`, `-o`, ...) are rejected. A task's own `flags` replace these. When you have not set this, flags from cpptools' `C_Cpp.default.defines`, `includePath` (workspace paths only), `cppStandard` and `cStandard` (each applied only to its own language), and `compilerArgs` are added too (see `vscwclang.useCppToolsSettings`).  `${workspaceFolder}` (as `/workspace`), `${workspaceFolderBasename}`, `${file}` and the other file variables are expanded; `${env:}`, `${command:}` and `${input:}` are not supported.

vscwclang.sourceGlobs.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the workspace folder, of the source files that `vscwClang: Build` compiles together into one program. Narrow this (e.g. `["src/**/*.cpp"]`) when the folder holds several programs, such as tests that each define `main`. A leading `${workspaceFolder}/` is accepted and ignored.

vscwclang.indexing.enabled.markdownDescription: Index the workspace's source files in the background so go-to-definition, find symbol and completion see the whole project, not just open files. Progress shows in the status bar. Turn off if editing feels sluggish while it runs; only open files are then known to the language server.

vscwclang.indexing.pauseMs.markdownDescription: Pause in milliseconds between files while indexing, leaving a gap for completion and hover requests. Raise it if the editor feels slow while indexing; lower it to finish indexing sooner.

vscwclang.indexing.holdOpenMs.markdownDescription: How long in milliseconds each file is held open for the language server to parse it while indexing. Raise it for very large files that end up only partly indexed.

vscwclang.compileCommands.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative path of the `compile_commands.json` that Build and Run use when there is no default `tasks.json` build task; a string or a list, of which the first is used (same shape as cpptools' `C_Cpp.default.compileCommands`, which is the fallback when this is empty; `${workspaceFolder}/` prefixes are accepted). Empty looks for `compile_commands.json`, then `build/compile_commands.json`. Each source is compiled with the flags of its own entry; a CMake database with several targets asks which one to build.

vscwclang.compileCommands.include.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the workspace folder, that narrow which `compile_commands.json` entries are linked into the program (for databases of several programs that do not name CMake targets). Empty keeps them all. A leading `${workspaceFolder}/` is accepted and ignored.

vscwclang.files.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the workspace folder, of files and folders that are never compiled or indexed: IDE scratch folders and build output by default. Same shape as cpptools' `C_Cpp.files.exclude` (`true` excludes, `false` un-excludes a default), which is merged in unless `vscwclang.useCppToolsSettings` is off. Supports `**`, `*`, `?` and `{a,b}`, ignoring case. A file named explicitly by a task or compile database is never excluded. A leading `${workspaceFolder}/` is accepted and ignored.

vscwclang.run.args.markdownDescription: Arguments for `vscwClang: Build and Run`. A `launch.json` configuration (`cppdbg`, `cppvsdbg`, `lldb`, `codelldb`) that has `args` takes precedence. `vscwClang: Build and Run with Arguments...` asks each time instead (pre-filled with the last answer).  `${workspaceFolder}` (as `/workspace`), `${workspaceFolderBasename}`, `${file}` and the other file variables are expanded; `${env:}`, `${command:}` and `${input:}` are not supported.

vscwclang.run.env.markdownDescription: Environment variables for the program, added to the defaults `HOME=/home/user`, `TMPDIR=/tmp`, `USER=user`, `LANG=C.UTF-8`. Set a variable to `null` to remove a default. `${workspaceFolder}` and the other variables are expanded in values (as in `vscwclang.run.args`).

vscwclang.toolTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds to wait for each clang or wasm-ld invocation before stopping it and reporting an error. Compilers print nothing while working, so a crashed run cannot be told apart from a slow one; raise this for very large sources. `0` disables the timeout.

vscwclang.useCppToolsSettings.markdownDescription: Use the C/C++ extension's `C_Cpp.default.*` settings (`defines`, `includePath`, `cppStandard`, `cStandard`, `compilerArgs`) as extra flags when `vscwclang.flags` is not set, and its `C_Cpp.files.exclude`, `C_Cpp.default.compileCommands`, `C_Cpp.loggingLevel` and `C_Cpp.intelliSenseEngine` as defaults. Lets a project configured for cpptools on desktop work here unchanged.

vscwclang.intelliSense.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the clangd language server for completion, hover, go-to-definition and as-you-type diagnostics. Turn off to skip clangd's download, memory use and indexing when you only need Build and Run. Defaults to off if `C_Cpp.intelliSenseEngine` is `disabled`. Reload the window to apply.

vscwclang.loggingLevel.markdownDescription: How much of clangd's log to show in the `vscwclang` output channel (same values as cpptools' `C_Cpp.loggingLevel`, which is the default when this is unset). `None` and `Error` show only errors. Reload the window to apply.

commands.title: vscwClang: Build and Run C++ with Arguments... (clang.wasm)

program.description: Not used yet: Debug builds the workspace in debug mode (the same sources and flags as Run) and debugs the result.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first instrumented block of the program instead of running to the first breakpoint.

command.description: g++, gcc, clang++ or clang (a full path is fine). The arguments are mapped onto a browser build; see the vscwClang README.

sources.description: Source globs relative to the workspace folder. Default: all .c/.cc/.cpp/.cxx files.

flags.description: Extra clang flags; -l, -L and -Wl, flags go to wasm-ld.

output.description: Output .wasm, relative to the workspace folder.

scripts.pretest: node scripts/make-toolchain-dist.mjs --release llvm-artifacts --dist llvm-artifacts/dist --if-missing && npm run compile-web
scripts.compile-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
